3. Who can use it

Bloggers writing about EU selling, accountants sharing resources with clients, marketplace consultants, and course creators teaching VAT — anyone may embed the widget for free. The “Free EU VAT calculator by VatSnap” link below the widget is a normal followable link back to our homepage; please keep it so the free ride keeps going.
